resources.string: Two quick steps and NoSpam is ready to filter spam on this device.
Everything happens on this device. NoSpam has no internet permission, so your messages cannot leave your phone.

To read and send SMS, to show the names of people you know instead of bare numbers, and to see which SIM a message belongs to. Contacts also tell the spam filter who you trust, so their messages are never hidden.
Android will not ask again, because the request was declined twice. You can still allow these in the app\'s settings.
Android only lets the default SMS app send messages and save them to the phone\'s message store.
